title: NVIDIA nvidia-smi: Utilization
paraphrase: GPU utilization is a busy-time fraction over a past sample period; documentation states a product-dependent period between 1/6 second and 1 second.
limit: This does not establish the actual underlying period for the installed Thor backend, nor the CPU-to-GPU lead. Faster polling alone is not an independent measurement.

title: jetson-stats jtop API
paraphrase: Documents per-core CPU properties and JSON export; actual service interval can differ from requested user interval; an existing service can determine the interval.
limit: The current online documentation identifies version 7.2.2. It does not identify the installed device version, supported minimum interval, actual update rate or overhead.

title: NVIDIA Tegrastats Utility r38.2.1
paraphrase: Describes per-core CPU utilization/frequency, RAM use, memory-controller activity, thermal and rail statistics; output interval uses milliseconds.
limit: A print interval is not proof of the resolution of every metric; original rail meanings and platform-specific data sources must be retained.

title: vLLM Architecture Overview
paraphrase: API processing, scheduling/KV management and GPU execution have separate roles.
limit: Generic architecture is not a timing trace of this installed engine, nor proof that every request reads KV on CPU before GPU work.

title: vLLM Model Runner V2: Async-First
paraphrase: Describes overlapping CPU preparation for a following step with GPU execution of the current step.
limit: This design document does not prove the installed engine uses MRV2; it only prevents assuming every inference engine always has a simple non-overlapping CPU-then-GPU sequence.

title: vLLM Engine Arguments: cache configuration
paraphrase: KV cache memory budget and CPU offloading are configurable engine behavior.
limit: Do not infer allocation size equals active request count, or presume CPU KV offloading was enabled on this run.

title: NVIDIA CUDA for Tegra: Memory Management
paraphrase: Host/device/unified allocations on Tegra share physical SoC DRAM, with different access and caching behavior.
limit: RAM allocation is not a direct heat/PWM measurement and does not calibrate the loaded-idle cooling baseline.
